title: seseli lanzhouense
intro: Seseli lanzhouense, commonly known as Chinese Seseli, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) that has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Seseli lanzhouense are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, calm the nervous system, and clear heat from the body. The bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
